# Check if the Sentence Is Pangram.

@example The three rows of a keyboard, read backwards: each of the 26 letters exactly once.
"mnbvcxzlkjhgfdsapoiuytrewq"
=> true

@example Only a, g, i and z turn up.
"zigzag"
=> false

@example 29 letters, but z never shows up.
"qwertyuiopasdfghjklxcvbnmpoiu"
=> false

# A single letter.
"a"
=> false

# 25 different letters: everything but z.
"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy"
=> false

# All 26 letters once each, in reverse order.
"zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba"
=> true

# 26 letters, but only 13 different ones, each twice.
"aabbccddeeffgghhiijjkkllmm"
=> false

# 300 letters with every letter but a.
""
=> false

# 1000 letters with every letter but m.
""
=> false

# e occurs exactly 256 times, which wraps a count kept in an unsigned
# char back to 0.
"abcdeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
=> true

# z occurs 128 times, which overflows a count kept in a signed char.
"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz"
=> true

# 1000 letters whose only z is the last one.
""
=> true

# 1000 copies of one letter.
""
=> false

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"qbjgiyhtncyxslwmkdenrfpuzov"
=> false

@gen 2 small
"jfwobnmpgyhrlxqziuvtdgckseqa"
=> true

@gen 3 small
"zzb"
=> false

@gen 4 small
"lyubjrwljtfvsnpgaqkhhpuecqxmihdnio"
=> false

@gen 5 small
"aukymjhbeitrscdgpnxvqlrwof"
=> false

@gen 6 small
"ktupbjvralhzexwnysfdmiqcgo"
=> true

# Full size: 1000 letters.
@gen 1
""
=> false

@gen 2
""
=> true
